title: Positions read on their own on a fixed period, so a new connection never waits on a manual step (G-02-5)
reference_behaviour: Positions are re-read from the broker on a fixed period of about 45 s without the user doing anything.
ours: NEW AC NEEDED: the position-sync row tells the user to open Execute to make a read happen; a first connect may never read positions. Read once at connect, then on a period.
